pros.title: a little feta can change a whole plate
pros.explanation: The salty tang means a small crumble can wake up salads, eggs, wraps, and vegetables.

pros.title: real feta has a Protected Designation of Origin
pros.explanation: In the European Union, it has to come from Greece and use sheep's milk, sometimes mixed with goat's milk.

pros.title: the crumble format is genuinely useful
pros.explanation: You can spread flavour across a meal without needing a thick slab of cheese.

cons.title: the salt is the real catch
cons.explanation: Brining pushes sodium to roughly 1.1 grams per 100 grams, so portions matter even before the saturated fat gets involved.

cons.title: it is still a dairy food
cons.explanation: Milk allergy or poor dairy tolerance can rule it out completely.

cons.title: the sharp flavour can take over
cons.explanation: Feta works brilliantly as an accent, but it is not always what you want dominating the entire meal.
